output.reason: Evidence shows (1) the RBI “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” was withdrawn/repealed effective 2025-11-28 and is “no longer in force” as of 2026-11-23, and (2) the RBI 2014 “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans” was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2026-01-01 and is also “no longer in force” as of 2026-11-23. Therefore, the withdrawn 2014 and 2025 pre-payment charge directions do not control as of the as-of date (2026-11-23).
